subject.title: feat: add hosted feed envelope verifier

question: Should OpenClaw accept this hosted feed signed-envelope verifier as the first trust-boundary slice before the config, refresh, and default ClawHub feed follow-ups land?
rationale: The patch is bounded and reviewed cleanly, but it establishes the signature-verification primitive for marketplace feed trust and is labeled for maintainer handling.

options.title: Accept the verifier slice
options.body: Land the lazy verifier primitive after exact-head gate reconciliation and continue reviewing the stacked runtime/config follow-ups separately.

options.title: Hold for the full stack
options.body: Defer this PR until maintainers can review the verifier, config, refresh, trust-state, and default-feed behavior as one security boundary.

options.title: Request a different trust API shape
options.body: Keep the PR open and ask for a narrower or differently owned verifier surface before follow-up PRs depend on it.

recommendation.title: Accept the verifier slice
recommendation.body: Land the lazy verifier primitive after exact-head gate reconciliation and continue reviewing the stacked runtime/config follow-ups separately.
